key_decisions.decision: Keeps sons plural and burning explicit, not a harmless passage-through-fire euphemism.
Retains enormous casualty figure, one-day span, and narrative explanation.
Retains kinship and explicit civilian categories alongside the stated count.
Preserves prophetic indictment of victors despite divine handing over.
Keeps gendered enslavement and the question exposing captors' guilt.
Preserves all four named leaders and fathers.
Retains every concrete act of care, repeated clothing, and both destinations.
Retains Hebrew plural kings instead of silently substituting singular.
Retains source title Israel and distinguishes social disorder from covenant unfaithfulness.
Preserves Chronicles' name form and failed military help.
Keeps Ahaz's reasoning as his speech and narrator's contrary outcome.
Keeps Israel's kings and burial exclusion, with successor clearly identified.
